verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a searchable query stats table where you can drill down to a single execution with its time breakdown and see grouped error signatures. It also exposes the full stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable across the whole cluster, which gives a data-engineer query profiles for diagnosing slow or expensive queries. Execution plans are only implied by the claim that every ClickHouse query works unchanged. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of EXPLAIN/execution-plan inspection, per-query cost/resource attribution details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
